annotations.title: Answer the questions an application is waiting on

description: Submits person-stated answers to an application's open questions against actionVersion and each requestRevision. statedByPerson:true attests that the values came from the account holder. Answering the last open question queues the application to be submitted under the account holder's name. Always returns a confirmation hold first, whose summary quotes each question and answer; changed questions return a conflict to re-read.

confirmationToken.description: Echo the token from a previous `held` result to carry out the act it described, and only after the person has seen that result's summary and agreed to it. Send identical arguments: the token is bound to the exact call it was issued for, so a changed argument is held again with a fresh token and a fresh summary. It lasts two minutes and is spent once.

statedByPerson.description: The person gave every value here in this conversation. Never assumed.

name: answer_application_questions
